description: Onboard IoT devices to a network from registration through telemetry verification.

steps.description: Register the device in the management platform with its identity and metadata.

inputs.name: device-type
inputs.desc: The model and type of IoT device

inputs.name: deployment-location
inputs.desc: Where the device will be installed

outputs.name: device-record
outputs.desc: The registered device record with unique ID

outputs.name: network-config
outputs.desc: Network connection parameters for the device

process: Assign the device a unique identifier in the management platform.
Record the device metadata (type, manufacturer, firmware version, deployment location).
Select and document the network connection type and parameters.

steps.description: Provision the device with security credentials and certificates.

outputs.name: provisioned-credentials
outputs.desc: The device credentials and certificates

outputs.name: security-profile
outputs.desc: The security configuration applied to the device

process: Generate or assign the device credentials (API keys, tokens, or X.509 certificates).
Configure the device with the network credentials and connection parameters.
Verify the device can authenticate against the management platform.

steps.description: Verify the device is sending data correctly to the platform.

outputs.name: telemetry-status
outputs.desc: Confirmation that data is flowing correctly

outputs.name: data-sample
outputs.desc: A sample of the received telemetry data

process: Trigger a test data transmission from the device.
Confirm the data arrives at the platform with correct schema and timestamps.
Validate the data values are within expected ranges.

steps.description: Set up monitoring and alerting for the onboarded device.

outputs.name: monitoring-config
outputs.desc: The monitoring and alerting configuration

outputs.name: onboarding-record
outputs.desc: The complete device onboarding record

process: Define the health metrics to monitor (connectivity, battery, signal strength, uptime).
Set the alert thresholds for each metric.
Configure the notification channels for alerts (email, SMS, webhook).
Compile the complete onboarding record.

description: Build a sensor data pipeline from schema definition through visualization.

steps.description: Define the data schema for sensor telemetry.

inputs.name: sensor-types
inputs.desc: The types of sensors and their measurements

inputs.name: data-requirements
inputs.desc: What the data will be used for

outputs.name: data-schema
outputs.desc: The schema definition (sensor ID, timestamp, value, unit, metadata)

outputs.name: validation-rules
outputs.desc: Rules for data validation (ranges, types, required fields)

process: List each sensor type and the measurements it produces.
Define the fields for each telemetry record (sensor ID, timestamp, value, unit).
Set the validation rules for each field (data type, allowed range, required vs optional).

steps.description: Configure the ingestion endpoint for receiving sensor data.

outputs.name: ingestion-config
outputs.desc: The configured ingestion endpoint (protocol, address, authentication)

outputs.name: ingestion-docs
outputs.desc: Documentation for devices to send data to the endpoint

process: Select the ingestion protocol (MQTT, HTTP, Kafka) based on the data volume and latency needs.
Configure the endpoint with the data schema and validation rules.
Set up authentication for the ingestion endpoint.
Document the endpoint address, protocol, and payload format.

steps.description: Configure the time-series database for storing sensor data.

outputs.name: storage-config
outputs.desc: The database configuration (schema, retention, partitioning)

outputs.name: query-interface
outputs.desc: The query interface for accessing stored data

process: Create the database tables or collections matching the data schema.
Configure the retention policy (how long to keep raw data, when to downsample).
Set up the partitioning strategy for query performance.
Verify data flows from ingestion to storage correctly.

steps.description: Build the visualization layer for sensor data.

inputs.name: query-interface
inputs.desc: The query interface for stored data

outputs.name: dashboard-config
outputs.desc: The dashboard configuration with panels and queries

outputs.name: pipeline-documentation
outputs.desc: Complete documentation of the sensor data pipeline

process: Design the dashboard layout with panels for each sensor type.
Write the queries to populate each panel from the time-series store.
Configure the refresh interval and time range selectors.
Compile the full pipeline documentation (schema, ingestion, storage, visualization).

description: Set up smart home automations from device inventory through testing.

steps.description: Inventory all connected devices in the home.

inputs.name: home-layout
inputs.desc: The rooms and areas in the home

inputs.name: existing-devices
inputs.desc: Smart devices already installed or planned

outputs.name: device-inventory
outputs.desc: Complete list of devices by room with capabilities

outputs.name: integration-map
outputs.desc: Which devices can communicate with each other

process: List each smart device by room (lights, thermostat, locks, cameras, sensors, speakers).
Record each device's protocol (WiFi, Zigbee, Z-Wave, Bluetooth, Thread).
Map which devices are compatible with each other and with the central hub.

steps.description: Define the automation rules for schedules, triggers, and conditions.

outputs.name: automation-rules
outputs.desc: The defined automation rules (trigger, condition, action)

outputs.name: scene-definitions
outputs.desc: Scene configurations (away, sleep, morning, movie)

process: Define time-based automations (lights on at sunset, thermostat schedule, morning routine).
Define event-based automations (motion triggers lights, door lock triggers camera).
Design the scenes as named groups of device states (away mode, bedtime, good morning).

steps.description: Configure remote access, notifications, and user permissions.

outputs.name: access-config
outputs.desc: Remote access and notification configuration

outputs.name: user-permissions
outputs.desc: Who can control what devices and automations

process: Set up the remote access app with the correct hub and device connections.
Configure notifications for security events (door opens, motion detected, water leak).
Define user permissions (who can arm/disarm, who can control which rooms).

steps.description: Test each automation and scene to verify correct operation.

outputs.name: test-results
outputs.desc: Pass/fail results for each automation and scene

outputs.name: automation-plan
outputs.desc: The complete smart home automation plan

process: Trigger each automation manually and verify the expected devices respond.
Activate each scene and confirm all devices reach the correct state.
Test remote access from outside the home network.
Document any failures and their fixes in the final automation plan.

description: Set up industrial IoT monitoring from sensor identification through predictive maintenance.

steps.description: Identify the critical equipment and the sensors needed to monitor it.

inputs.name: monitoring-goals
inputs.desc: What the monitoring should detect (failure, wear, efficiency)

outputs.name: sensor-plan
outputs.desc: Which sensors to install on which equipment (vibration, temp, pressure, flow)

outputs.name: criticality-ranking
outputs.desc: Equipment ranked by criticality and monitoring priority

process: List each piece of equipment and its failure modes.
For each failure mode, identify the sensor type that detects early signs.
Rank the equipment by criticality (production impact, safety, replacement cost).
Assign monitoring priority based on the ranking.

steps.description: Configure the data collection from industrial sensors.

outputs.name: collection-config
outputs.desc: The data collection configuration (sampling rate, protocol, gateway)

outputs.name: data-flow-diagram
outputs.desc: Diagram of data flow from sensor to platform

process: Set the sampling rate for each sensor based on the measurement type and criticality.
Configure the industrial protocol (Modbus, OPC-UA, MQTT, BACnet).
Set up the gateway or edge device for protocol translation and buffering.

steps.description: Build real-time dashboards for the industrial monitoring data.

outputs.name: dashboard-layout
outputs.desc: The dashboard with panels for each equipment and metric

outputs.name: alert-rules
outputs.desc: Alert thresholds and escalation rules for each metric

process: Design the dashboard with an overview panel and drill-down panels per equipment.
Set the alert thresholds based on normal operating ranges and manufacturer specs.
Configure the escalation path (operator, supervisor, maintenance, management).

steps.description: Configure predictive maintenance triggers based on sensor trends.

outputs.name: predictive-triggers
outputs.desc: Rules that detect degradation trends before failure

outputs.name: monitoring-setup-document
outputs.desc: Complete industrial IoT monitoring documentation

process: Define the trend patterns that indicate degradation (rising temperature, increasing vibration).
Set the trigger thresholds for generating maintenance work orders.
Configure the integration with the maintenance management system.
Compile the complete monitoring setup documentation.

description: Manage an IoT device fleet from inventory through lifecycle retirement.

steps.description: Maintain the device inventory with type, location, firmware, and status.

inputs.name: fleet-scope
inputs.desc: The scope of the device fleet (all devices, a region, a product line)

inputs.name: device-data-sources
inputs.desc: Where device information is stored (management platform, spreadsheets, databases)

outputs.name: fleet-inventory
outputs.desc: Complete inventory with device ID, type, location, firmware, status

outputs.name: inventory-gaps
outputs.desc: Devices missing data or not yet registered

process: Collect device records from all data sources into a single inventory.
Reconcile duplicates and fill in missing fields.
Flag devices with outdated firmware, unknown status, or missing location data.

steps.description: Schedule and deploy firmware updates to the fleet.

outputs.name: update-schedule
outputs.desc: The firmware rollout schedule (which devices, when, in what order)

outputs.name: rollback-plan
outputs.desc: Plan for rolling back failed updates

process: Identify devices running outdated firmware.
Group devices into rollout waves (canary, early adopter, general).
Schedule each wave with a monitoring window between waves.
Define the rollback criteria and procedure for each wave.

steps.description: Monitor device health across the fleet.

outputs.name: health-report
outputs.desc: Fleet health summary (connectivity, battery, uptime by device group)

outputs.name: action-items
outputs.desc: Devices requiring intervention (offline, low battery, errors)

process: Collect health metrics from the management platform (last seen, battery level, error count, uptime).
Aggregate metrics by device type, location, and firmware version.
Identify devices that need intervention and categorize by urgency.

steps.description: Manage device lifecycle from provisioning through retirement.

outputs.name: lifecycle-actions
outputs.desc: Actions taken (replacements ordered, devices retired, warranties claimed)

outputs.name: fleet-management-report
outputs.desc: Complete fleet management report

process: For devices past their expected lifespan or with recurring failures, schedule replacement.
For retired devices, revoke credentials and remove from the inventory.
Track warranty claims for failed devices within warranty period.
Compile the fleet management report with health trends and lifecycle actions.

description: Set up edge computing for IoT from requirements through monitoring.

steps.description: Assess the processing requirements for edge computing.

inputs.name: use-case
inputs.desc: What the edge computing will do (local inference, data filtering, real-time control)

inputs.name: data-volume
inputs.desc: Expected data volume and latency requirements

outputs.name: edge-requirements
outputs.desc: Processing, storage, and network requirements for the edge

outputs.name: edge-vs-cloud-analysis
outputs.desc: What should run at the edge vs what should run in the cloud

process: List the processing tasks and their latency requirements.
Calculate the compute, memory, and storage needed for each task.
Determine which tasks must run at the edge (latency-critical, offline-capable) and which can run in the cloud.

steps.description: Select the edge hardware based on the requirements.

outputs.name: hardware-selection
outputs.desc: The selected edge hardware with specifications

outputs.name: deployment-plan
outputs.desc: How and where to deploy the edge nodes

process: Match the requirements to available hardware options (industrial gateways, single-board computers, edge servers).
Evaluate the options on compute power, environmental rating, connectivity, and cost.
Select the hardware and plan the physical deployment locations.

steps.description: Deploy the edge runtime and applications to the edge nodes.

outputs.name: runtime-config
outputs.desc: The deployed edge runtime configuration

outputs.name: sync-config
outputs.desc: Data sync configuration between edge and cloud

process: Install the edge runtime (container runtime, edge agent, or embedded OS).
Deploy the application containers or binaries to each edge node.
Configure the data sync between edge and cloud (frequency, conflict resolution, offline buffer).

steps.description: Set up monitoring for the edge nodes.

outputs.name: edge-monitoring
outputs.desc: Monitoring configuration for edge node health

outputs.name: edge-setup-document
outputs.desc: Complete edge computing setup documentation

process: Define the health metrics to monitor (CPU, memory, disk, network, sync lag).
Set up alerts for edge node failures or sync delays.
Configure remote management for firmware updates and troubleshooting.
Compile the complete edge computing setup documentation.

description: Harden IoT device security from firmware audit through service lockdown.

steps.description: Audit the device firmware for known vulnerabilities.

inputs.name: device-list
inputs.desc: The devices to audit (type, manufacturer, firmware version)

inputs.name: security-baseline
inputs.desc: The security standard to audit against

outputs.name: vulnerability-report
outputs.desc: List of vulnerabilities found in device firmware

outputs.name: update-recommendations
outputs.desc: Firmware updates or patches to apply

process: Extract the firmware version for each device.
Check each firmware version against known vulnerability databases (CVE, manufacturer advisories).
List the vulnerabilities by severity and recommend firmware updates or mitigations.

steps.description: Configure network segmentation to isolate IoT devices.

outputs.name: segmentation-config
outputs.desc: VLAN and firewall rule configuration

outputs.name: network-diagram
outputs.desc: Network diagram showing IoT segments

process: Group devices by trust level and function (cameras, sensors, actuators, management).
Create VLANs or network segments for each group.
Configure firewall rules to allow only necessary traffic between segments.
Block IoT devices from reaching the internet unless required for their function.

steps.description: Enable encrypted communication for IoT devices.

outputs.name: encryption-config
outputs.desc: TLS/DTLS configuration for each device class

outputs.name: auth-config
outputs.desc: Device authentication configuration (certificates, tokens)

process: Enable TLS or DTLS on all device-to-platform communication.
Deploy certificates or rotate tokens for device authentication.
Verify encrypted connections are working and unencrypted fallback is disabled.

steps.description: Disable unused ports and services on IoT devices.

outputs.name: lockdown-checklist
outputs.desc: Checklist of services disabled and ports closed per device

outputs.name: hardening-report
outputs.desc: Complete security hardening report

process: Scan each device for open ports and running services.
Disable services not required for the device's function (telnet, FTP, UPnP, debug interfaces).
Close unnecessary ports and change default credentials.
Compile the hardening report with before/after state for each device.

description: Deploy an environmental sensor network from parameter definition through calibration.

steps.description: Define the monitoring parameters and sensor selection.

inputs.name: monitoring-area
inputs.desc: The area to monitor (building, campus, city block, farm)

inputs.name: parameters-of-interest
inputs.desc: What to measure (air quality, temperature, humidity, noise, light)

outputs.name: parameter-spec
outputs.desc: Specification for each parameter (range, precision, sampling rate)

outputs.name: sensor-selection
outputs.desc: Selected sensors with specifications and quantities

process: For each parameter, define the measurement range, required precision, and sampling frequency.
Select sensors that meet the specifications (accuracy, power, connectivity, weatherproofing).
Calculate the number of sensors needed based on the area and spatial resolution.

steps.description: Plan the physical placement of sensors in the monitoring area.

outputs.name: placement-map
outputs.desc: Map showing sensor locations with rationale

outputs.name: installation-plan
outputs.desc: Installation instructions for each sensor site

process: Map the monitoring area and identify placement locations based on spatial coverage.
Account for environmental factors (airflow, shade, interference, power access).
Document the mounting method, power source, and connectivity for each site.

steps.description: Configure the data collection and transmission from the sensor network.

outputs.name: data-config
outputs.desc: Data collection and transmission configuration

outputs.name: dashboard-and-alerts
outputs.desc: Dashboard and alerting configuration for the network

process: Configure each sensor's data transmission (frequency, protocol, destination).
Set up the central dashboard with panels for each parameter and location.
Define the alert thresholds (air quality index levels, temperature extremes, noise limits).

steps.description: Schedule and manage sensor calibration to maintain accuracy.

outputs.name: calibration-schedule
outputs.desc: Calibration schedule and procedures for each sensor type

outputs.name: sensor-network-plan
outputs.desc: Complete environmental sensor network plan

process: Define the calibration interval for each sensor type (monthly, quarterly, annually).
Document the calibration procedure (reference standards, adjustment steps, acceptance criteria).
Set up reminders and tracking for calibration due dates.
Compile the complete sensor network plan.

description: Set up a building management system from systems inventory through alarm configuration.

steps.description: Inventory all building systems to integrate into the BMS.

inputs.name: building-info
inputs.desc: Building details (size, floors, age, systems installed)

inputs.name: management-goals
inputs.desc: What the BMS should achieve (energy savings, comfort, compliance, security)

outputs.name: systems-inventory
outputs.desc: Complete inventory of building systems (HVAC, lighting, access, fire, elevators)

outputs.name: integration-requirements
outputs.desc: Protocol and connectivity requirements for each system

process: List each building system and its components (HVAC units, lighting zones, access points, fire panels).
Record the communication protocol for each system (BACnet, Modbus, LonWorks, proprietary).
Identify which systems can integrate directly and which need protocol converters.

steps.description: Integrate the building systems into the BMS platform.

outputs.name: integration-status
outputs.desc: Status of each system's integration (connected, partial, pending)

outputs.name: point-list
outputs.desc: Complete list of data points available in the BMS

process: Connect each system to the BMS platform using the appropriate protocol driver.
Verify each data point is reading correctly (temperatures, status, setpoints, alarms).
Document any systems that could not be integrated and the workaround plan.

steps.description: Configure the control schedules and setpoints in the BMS.

outputs.name: schedule-config
outputs.desc: HVAC, lighting, and access schedules by zone and day

outputs.name: energy-monitoring-config
outputs.desc: Energy monitoring configuration (meters, dashboards, targets)

process: Set the HVAC schedules by zone (occupied hours, setback hours, weekend, holiday).
Set the lighting schedules by zone (auto-on/off, daylight harvesting, occupancy).
Configure energy monitoring by meter and set baseline targets.

steps.description: Define the alarm and notification rules for the BMS.

outputs.name: alarm-rules
outputs.desc: Alarm definitions with priority, notification method, and escalation

outputs.name: bms-setup-document
outputs.desc: Complete BMS setup documentation

process: Define alarms for each system (temperature out of range, equipment failure, security breach, fire).
Assign priority levels (critical, high, medium, low) and notification methods (page, email, display).
Set escalation rules for unacknowledged alarms.
Compile the complete BMS setup documentation.

description: Integrate wearable device data from schema definition through reporting.

steps.description: Define the data types to collect from wearable devices.

inputs.name: wearable-devices
inputs.desc: The wearable devices to integrate (fitness bands, smartwatches, medical devices)

inputs.name: data-use-case
inputs.desc: How the wearable data will be used (wellness programs, clinical monitoring, research)

outputs.name: data-types
outputs.desc: List of data types to collect (steps, heart rate, sleep, SpO2, location)

outputs.name: privacy-requirements
outputs.desc: Privacy and consent requirements for the collected data

process: List each wearable device and the data types it produces.
Select the data types needed for the use case.
Document the privacy and consent requirements (opt-in, anonymization, retention limits).

steps.description: Configure the API or SDK integration with each wearable platform.

outputs.name: api-config
outputs.desc: API integration configuration for each wearable platform

outputs.name: auth-flow
outputs.desc: User authentication and consent flow for data access

process: Register the application with each wearable platform's developer portal.
Configure the OAuth or API key authentication for data access.
Implement the user consent flow that explains what data is collected and why.

steps.description: Normalize wearable data from different platforms into a common schema.

outputs.name: common-schema
outputs.desc: The normalized data schema with mappings from each platform

outputs.name: data-store-config
outputs.desc: Storage configuration for the normalized data

process: Design the common schema that accommodates data from all platforms.
Map each platform's field names, units, and formats to the common schema.
Configure the data store with the common schema and set up automated ingestion.

steps.description: Build the reporting layer for wearable data.

outputs.name: reports
outputs.desc: Reports and dashboards for the wearable data

outputs.name: integration-document
outputs.desc: Complete wearable data integration documentation

process: Build the individual user dashboard (daily activity, sleep trends, health metrics).
Build the aggregate reporting layer (population trends, program participation, anomalies).
Set up automated report generation on the chosen schedule.
Compile the complete integration documentation.
